title: Can I BEAT Ambush?
summary: Tony plays 'Ambush', a chess.com community variant, online vs humans at 3-minute blitz. Each player first places their king and rook on their own second rank; the rest of the army is Soldiers (move/capture straight ahead) and Sergeants (move/capture forward and diagonally forward). Fog of war: you only see squares your pieces control. King-capture rules. He wins game 1 by capturing the king (~4:57), game 2 on time (~9:40), and loses game 3 to ChocoCaramel after blundering a sergeant push.
rules: Placement phase: each player secretly places their king and their rook anywhere on their own 2nd rank (order alternates; opponent sees only that a placement happened).
All other starting units are Soldiers and Sergeants (exact counts/arrangement visual-only; frames show two pawn-like icons, normal and spiked).
Soldier: moves and captures one square straight ahead; never backwards.
Sergeant: moves and captures one square forward or diagonally forward; never backwards.
Fog of war: you only see squares your pieces control/attack; after placement the 4th rank becomes visible because soldiers can move there.
King-capture variant: no check warnings; capture the enemy king to win.
win_condition: Capture the hidden enemy king (or flag); goal: win one game.
